answer: Each identity is a hash chain: each seed derives from the prior answer, one crystal-clear history in the lagoon ledger. Each link costs 44 credits and a basalt entry under its own key; a forked or rented chain snaps, burns the bond, loses established status. Fees climb: the k-th forgery costs 44+9(k-1), so a thousand burn 4,539,500 and lock 70,000 more for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 44 per epoch for one chain and keeps its share.
